correlation/identity.gap: Verify source-anchor and password-authority fields; use a reviewed Microsoft export only for missing fields.

correlation/sync.gap: Confirm host/agent/tenant binding from supported configuration or inventory; no hostname guessing.

correlation/federation.gap: Issuer, PTA and SSO configuration or key-use metadata may need narrow reviewed exports; never extract secrets.

correlation/trust.gap: Additional tenant, DNS or Application Proxy context needs scoped evidence; trust presence alone proves no path.

correlation/group.gap: Verify target-service nesting, provisioning and Conditional Access semantics rather than assuming transitive access.

correlation/application.gap: Arc, Hybrid Worker and host credential-use boundaries require separate approved resource/host evidence.

correlation/certificate.gap: Use upstream AD CS semantics; separately verify CA host protection and Entra CBA trust and mapping.

correlation/kerberos.gap: Observed privileged sessions and recovery-copy metadata need explicit scope; do not request tickets or secrets.

correlation/host.gap: Host methods, effective deny rights, network policy, virtualization and backup roles require explicit evidence.

correlation/policy.gap: Resultant policy and advisory applicability cannot be inferred from GPO links or an OS label alone.

correlation/visibility.gap: Use approved telemetry and effective audit exports; no events in a quiet period is not proof of disabled logging.

correlation/recovery.gap: Use existing backup-product reports and dated owner evidence; no backup extraction or recovery execution.

posture/directory.gap: Existing provider coverage must be checked per rule; no unreviewed replacement ACL scanner.

posture/auth.gap: Select the actual server role/build baseline and review missing effective authentication fields.

posture/server.gap: Prefer approved host/configuration exports; do not apply baselines or invent patch applicability.

posture/operations.gap: Owner, lifecycle, usage coverage and recovery attestations are not automatically available from a directory scan.
